rows.short_description: Keep the Lights On is an atmospheric horror game where you step in the shoes of Edmund Rosental, a private detective, who is tasked with investigating an old abbey and the mystery surrounding it. Will he be able to keep the lights on or will he succumb to the darkness
rows.description_html: Keep the Lights On is an atmospheric horror game where you step in the shoes of Edmund Rosental, a private detective, who is tasked with investigating an old abbey and the mystery surrounding it. Will he be able to keep the lights on or will he succumb to the darkness? In Keep the Lights On, the player will experience a terrifying tale of horror by exploring the environments, interacting with the environments and completing puzzles. The player can discover hidden sections of the abbey with platforming and defend himself from the darkness with holy water. As the player explores and solves mysteries, the dark past of the haunted abbey will be uncovered. A complete story of Keep the Lights On Introquet puzzles that will make you think Platform sections, what’s that up there? Enemies Ready to Snuff Of Your Light Completely Original Soundtrack Gorgeous Pixel Art Controller Support A Horror Game Experience Inspired By the Classics And Secrets Edmund Rosental, a private detective has fallen to dark times after the passing of his wife and he is offered a case to investigate a long abandoned abbey that has been rumoured to be haunted. Edmund accepts the job inorder to escape his dark and lonely existence. In Keep the Lights on, Edmund has to uncover the dark past of the abbey and face his own darkness.

rows.name: Lust from Beyond: Scarlet
rows.short_description: 'Lust from Beyond: Scarlet' is a stand-alone, free introduction to the full version of 'Lust from Beyond' - a horror game with elements of eroticism and occultism. This is not a demo version - you won't experience any spoilers here.
rows.description_html: 'Lust from Beyond: Scarlet' is a stand-alone, free introduction to the full version of 'Lust from Beyond' - a horror game with elements of eroticism and occultism. This is not a demo version - you won't experience any spoilers here. The presented story is unique to this title. 'LFB: Scarlet' is the second introduction to the Lust from Beyond. The goal of this title is to present topics and mechanics not mentioned in 'LFB: Prologue'. This time we will focus more on survival, gore and sexual elements. Moreover, we will present a new faction - Scarlet Lodge. Alan's mind is possessed by a hardly satisfiable sexual drive. To control his emotions, Alan meets with a psychiatrist who is supposed to solve his problems. During the session, Alan talks about a strange date in an abandoned theatre. The story quickly turns into an experience filled with dread and dark desires... - Bold erotic motives adapted to the horror convention - Interactive sex - Running from your opponents and fighting mechanics - A world inspired by the works of Lovecraft, Giger and Beksinski - Exploration of graphically advanced environment full of interactive objects - Ingenious puzzles - Vibrant sound and music

rows.name: Silk Roads: Caravan Kings
rows.short_description: In Silk Roads: Caravan Kings you follow in the footsteps of the legendary Marco Polo on a journey into Cathay in search of riches and adventure.
rows.description_html: In Silk Roads: Caravan Kings you follow in the footsteps of the legendary Marco Polo on a journey into Cathay in search of riches and adventure. Forge Your Own Journey This solo developed indie game puts you in control of a journey through a foreign world scarcely explored in popular media, including the famous Mongolian Steppes, the sandy deserts of Arabia, the wet jungles of India and the civilized empire of China. You can choose your path across the world. Create Your Destiny Over 100 unique events will challenge you on your journey, with multiple endings, luck based decisions and unique artwork. Live the Perilous Life Managing your supplies, camel train, health and morale as you travel across a hand drawn map. Trade Across the World Stop in over 30 cities along the roads for a chance to rest, recuperate, resupply & work. Visit the markets of distant lands and trade your way to China. Walk the Roads Manage your relations with the various cultures on the routes to Cathay, improve your skills to help you trade and obtain essential equipment.

rows.name: Dark Dealings
rows.short_description: The only way to rise to the top in this world is the hard way, so get on your bike and get to work!
rows.description_html: Dark Dealings is a unique 3D open-world experience and a re-imagining of the classic 'Dope Wars' trading game set in a quirky world your goal is to become the best in the business and rise to the top the hard way, on the streets! Its time to get on your bike and meet your customer's demands! The clock is ticking. Explore a vast open 3D world populated with unique characters and items! Learn the markets and make a killing trading in illicit substances. Warning, your perceptions may be altered! Hack into motor vehicles and go for a joy ride! Craft new substances and improve your profits! Enjoy the views on the open ocean or a bike ride through the park! Purchase properties and businesses to expand your empire! Trade in stocks and shares on the open market! Watch as the world develops through your actions! Over 100 songs to enjoy on the in game radios! Dark Dealings is an ever expanding world and you can expect many new features being added in the future including a full quest line and the possibility of online play. Every game developed at Tegridy Ltd also comes complete with the Tegridy Promise No Micro-transactions , No Subscriptions and No Dlc's. No DRM No Exclusives One Game, One Price!

rows.name: SCP: Labrat
rows.short_description: You are a test subject in the underground SCP research facility. When a containment breach occurs, you must find your way out. Escape the SCPs, discover anomalous objects, and collect valuable resources along the way.
rows.description_html: You are a test subject in the underground SCP facility. When a containment breach occurs, you must find your way out. Escape the SCPs, discover anomalous objects, and collect valuable resources along the way. SCP: Labrat is a recreation of SCP - Containment Breach by Undertow Games, developed by Bezbro Games. SCP - Containment Breach (SCP - CB) is a 2012 horror game based on the fictional stories of the SCP Foundation. SCP: Labrat follows the original gameplay of SCP - CB and adds multiple features to improve the experience. Some SCP: Labrat features include: Singleplayer and Multiplayer modes. New SCPs, items, and events in addition to the originals. An immersive VR player suited with a full body and physics interaction. Multiple improvements to original SCP - Containment Breach assets.

rows.short_description: A short story-driven game about two inquisitors, Arun and Quila, investigating a murder. During the game you'll control both, each having their own set of skills you'll need to solve the mystery.
rows.description_html: A short story-driven game about two inquisitors, Arun and Quila, investigating a murder. During the game you'll control both, each having their own set of skills you'll need to solve the mystery. Inquisitor Arun. His skill set includes herbalism, necropsy, enduring odors, and high perception. Inquisitor Quila. Her skill set includes lockpicking, sneaking, and her small frame which allows her to squeeze into tight spaces. Point & click to interact with your surroundings Interesting environments to explore Crafting alchemical substances Beautiful pixel art graphics Engaging story & dialogue All found clues will be added to the notes Collectible lore books and recipes Two different paths to the end Beautifully crafted UI elements Particle effects and LWRP Lighting to bring life to the world. A smart cursor changes to reflect the currently controlled character.

rows.name: BattleStick 2
rows.short_description: BattleStick 2 is a humorous free-to-play physics-based 2D stickman Multiplayer Game where you fight other stickmen in an arena with loads of equipment to choose from! It's a direct successor to BattleStick!
rows.description_html: New Game: Stickforge BattleStick 2 is no longer maintained. I'm now focused on Stickforge – a fully moddable, upgraded evolution of BattleStick. Demo coming to Steam on June 3, 2025! About the Game IMPORTANT: BattleStick 2 isn't maintained anymore. Its successor, Stickforge, is set to release on Steam June 3, 2025. FREE 2D MULTIPLAYER game! You fight in 2D arenas against stickmen characters controlled by REAL people! Up to 20 players in online multiplayer battle modes Play with up to 4 friends in Squad mode TONS of stickman skins, weapons, throwables and headgear are available Funny physics for stick figures with advanced controls Full of memes and comical sounds Unique physics! During battles, you will be met with a number of unique and funny physics’ situations. You will be able to chop off stickman bodies into pieces, jump unrealistically high and blow up dead stickman bodies. A diverse range of equipment items! You will purchase and experience different types of weapons, ranging from melee to ranged weapons; stickman skins of trendy memes, historical characters, and MORE! You will be able to take part in themed battles like Elves vs Orcs along with themed maps. It will be extended to a lot of themes, like Romans vs Gauls and Vikings vs Saxons. We want you to laugh! Having fun and laughing hard is the most important part of the BattleStick franchise. Our secret sauce is to pair funny physics with any type of sound out of their original context, like a dog barking sound when you receive damage. So grab a drink, relax, and come play with us!

Our secret sauce is to pair funny physics with any type of sound out of their original context, like a dog barking sound when you receive damage. So grab a drink, relax, and come play with us!

rows.name: Zenith: Nexus
rows.short_description: Fight, explore, and lose yourself in an anime-inspired world built for VR. Two action-packed game modes available. How will you use your power?
rows.description_html: Unleash your inner warrior, rise up as an agent of Zenith! Zenith: Nexus has two action-packed game modes: Infinite Realms (Free to Play) Party up with friends in a free online action-adventure RPG! Slash mobs with magic and race across parkour challenges in quick session-based runs. Meet up with other players in the city to upgrade your gear or just hangout and shoot hoops before your next run. Team up with friends to tackle perilous dungeons, compete in PVP, or just explore a gorgeous anime world together. *Players who purchased The Last City before Feb 24, 2024, retain access and can launch The Last City from within Zenith: Nexus

rows.name: 6th Dimension
rows.short_description: You have been dropped into the 6th dimension. Let's hope you can make it back to reality.
rows.description_html: The 6th Dimension is a first person single player riddle and puzzle solving game. You play as a traveler going through the 6th dimension. Inside the 6th dimension you will find different eco-systems you must traverse. You must find a way to get back to your dimension, in order to do this you must navigate all eco-systems within the 6th dimension and find all the sacred texts that will unlock the doors back to your reality. Once you find the text, you will have to do a series of riddles and puzzles in order to collect the sacred text from that eco-system. Let's hope you can make it back to reality.

rows.name: A Shopping Trip to Eklan Tor
rows.short_description: Explore a tiny monster town in VR and search for hidden objects.
rows.description_html: Explore the cliff town of Eklan Tor , located in the Hidden Lands. Eklan Tor is one of the few places in the world of monsters where humans can be found. The task you've been given is to find various things that have been hidden inside buildings, behind trees, and inside containers. See if you can find em all! This virtual reality game is actually a prototype I made for a larger game I've started working on. I wanted to see how complex a world I could make in VR without the framerate dying. Turns out, pretty darn complex! Not only that, I wanted to create something that allowed someone to really explore an interactive miniature world. I spent so much time on it that I wanted to give people a chance to try it out themselves. It's a fairly short game, maybe a half hour long, so I decided to offer it for just a small amount (now FREE!). If you had a good time visiting this world and know someone with VR who might also enjoy going exploring, please let them know about this! I really want as many people to enjoy it as possible.

rows.name: Mind Muscle VR
rows.short_description: Improve your fitness level and mind-muscle connection using virtual reality and the power of visualization.
rows.description_html: Have you ever felt that you are secretly capable of much more? That your body can do more, but you have not unlocked this inner ability yet? Allow us to help bring out that part of you with this training. Improve the connection of your nervous system to your muscles, increasing the gains that you make when you work out. By exercising your nerves (even just once!) you could make your muscles perform faster, stronger, and better in every way. Perfect for: Athletes wanting to maximize their performance. Power-lifters looking to push their body to it's real limits (or better). Elderly or disabled people who want an easy but effective workout. A pre-workout pump. Changing your body into the shape you want--using your mind. Rest days. Simply pick up the virtual weights and use the guided movement meditations to enhance your muscular performance. There are no points, no tracking, and no gold stars to achieve. Use this as a tool for your advancement. There is no special state of mind to achieve. Just feel into the sensations of your own body as you listen to the guided audio. This will improve the precision of control that you have with your body. You may want to return regularly for a refresher, but even just one focused practice session can have a profound effect on your future workouts, making your muscle control very precise. This VR fitness training is based on techniques from real peer-reviewed studies. Here are the links to the research papers: Strength gains by motor imagery with different ratios of physical to mental practice (/) Developing Competitive Endurance Performance Using Mental Skills Training () Imaginary training can replace the real thing (-log.com/imaginarytrainingrealthing.html) Imagery training makes calf muscles stronger (-log.com/imaginary.html)

rows.name: Couplinked
rows.short_description: Couplinked is an unforgiving, open source, action-arcade game with a unique control system. Steer two balls through treacherous obstacles while trying to collect rings for points. Play with up to three of your closest friends in local co-op for some ball-busting fun!
rows.description_html: Couplinked is Open Source! Couplinked is now open source! Click the 'Open Source' button under the game's 'Socials' menu to see the code! About the Game Couplinked is an unforgiving, open source, action-arcade game with a unique control system. Steer two balls through treacherous obstacles while trying to collect rings for points. Play with up to three of your closest friends in local co-op for some ball-busting fun! Did we mention that Couplinked is difficult? Couplinked is DIFFICULT. Your balls are connected by LASERS...at least in the game. But don't worry! With multiple gameplay modes, a custom level editor, and over fifty handcrafted campaign levels, your tears of frustration will soon be washed away by the pure joy of knowing that everyone else sucks too. That's right. You're not alone, champ. We're here for you and we've got balls. Through the good and the bad, the thick and the thin, rest assured, you'll probably only be crying for the first day or so. It'll get better. You know Couplinked will treat you right. Awwww yeahhhhh.

rows.short_description: Botley can't do many things on his own. Good thing he has telepathy.

Key Features Possession System: You control Botley, and by extent control the world around him. Botley can't jump, shoot, or explode. but the objects he controls can. Fight bosses: With each of the three levels come a unique boss! Can you master telepathy and take them down? Embrace the UNKNOWN: Venture forth on a quest to gain freedom for all Robot-kind! Controller recommended!

rows.name: The Forgotten Island - v1.0
rows.short_description: When I opened the ancient scroll, I came to the forgotten island. There are medieval figures and buildings on this island. Some people are merchants and some are villagers. First I want to drink water and eat some food, and then explore the island to find a way back to the real world.
rows.description_html: This is a small open-world RPG game where players must explore various interactions within the game. By engaging in battles, players can level up and earn talent points. Each level can be completed by finishing all the tasks assigned. In addition, players can engage in farming, fishing, eating, and drinking within the game. It's entirely up to the players to discover their own unique ways of enjoying the game. How to play : ◆ Press 'W', 'A', 'S', 'D' to move. ◆ Hold 'E' beside food and bed to recharge vitality. ◆ Hold 'E' beside well to recharge stamina. ◆ Hold 'F' beside a NPC to fight with him. ◆ Upgrade your level and buy stronger equipments. Fighting rules : ◆ Attack include heavy attack and light attack. ◆ Attack can minus enemy's vitality but consume your stamina. ◆ Defend can stop enemy's attack without consuming stamina. ◆ Relax can restore stamina but with no defense. ◆ If you are attacked by an enemy, your recovery will be ineffective. Talent system : ◆ 1 Strength → 120 Vitality and 50 Stamina. ◆ 1 Agility → 5 Attack and 2 Armor. ◆ 1 Intelligence → 20 Crit, 20 Avoid and 40 Lucky. P.S. (1) More characters are included in the Premium version. (2) Game walkthroughs are uploaded to YouTube. (3) The content has been updated to version 1.5

rows.name: Interactive Empathy
rows.short_description: Two small experimental games made as part of a one-week game workshop in Zagreb, Croatia, as part of a project called 'Interactive Empathy - Citizenship & Storytelling in Video Games'. Inside is also a documentary video about the workshop, as well as a booklet about the whole project.
rows.description_html: Two small experimental games made as part of a one-week game workshop in Zagreb, Croatia, as part of a project called 'Interactive Empathy - Citizenship & Storytelling in Video Games'. Inside is also a documentary video about the workshop, as well as a booklet about the whole project. Games available in: - English - French - German The participants of the workshop were artists (not gamedev professionals), and they used Gamechuck's 'Interactive Comics Editor' to create their own interactive projects in this one week. The two games playable here were also exhibited in the Institut français de Zagreb in November 2020. These are the short summaries of each interactive comic / game: The first game, 'Empathy Path', is a horror video game in the form of an interactive comic, permeated with notions of morality and philosophical quotations. It is based on the theory of Heidi Maibom who divides empathy into affective (for example, when we cry because we see someone else crying) and cognitive empathy (when we put ourselves into other people’s shoes by reflecting). The players of this game will find themselves in a slaughter house with five characters: a trapped girl, a suicidal clown, a pig, a butcher and artificial intelligence. In order to free the girl, the players need to empathize with all the characters, since all of them play a role in her liberation. By empathizing with individual characters, the player must literally delve into their perspective, which turns the character - an object - into the subject. Such changes of perspective and “empathy paths” lead the players to the initial position. However, we must warn the players of the responsibility before them, because the “empathy path” continues within them. Art and story by Andrea Pleša and Matija Vigato. The second game, 'There Is No Cure (And That's Okay)' is conceived as a simulator of first-person experience, based on the stories and experiences of people suffering from mild and severe mental illnesses. It deals with the conditions in which they find themselves and the changes of their perception of the world during the performance of ordinary activities. As the player explores the world around them and interacts with it, glitches, i.e. discrepancies in the perception of reality occur. Interaction with the world can be (de)motivating, depending on objects and persons in the given situation. The aim of the game is to make players aware that mental illnesses are not and should not be a taboo and that everyone deserves a chance and other people’s understanding in these sometimes sadly immutable situations. However, the latter can be controlled, thus maintaining the quality of life, if individuals and their environment invest a great deal of effort and willingness. Art and story by Alma Trtovac.

rows.name: Party Maker Farm Fest
rows.short_description: Builder. Designer. Renovator. Unleash your creativity in over a dozen unique places, get the right equipment, prepare the space, use what you find. Have a crazy farm party, here we go!
rows.description_html: Party Maker Farm Fest is a simulator of an event agency that organizes events in amazing places. Birthdays, weddings, bachelor parties or Halloween fun in an extraordinary space. Unleash your creativity, get the right equipment, prepare a place, use what you find. In the Party Maker Farm Fest, you will have the opportunity to organize the summer fair. However, you will also have to prove that you can handle it. Clear the level of rubbish to pimp the party spot. Lots of amazing decorations to choose from. To get a REAL blast, you might want to design your own firework show! Discover additional activities and unique quests on each level. If you like puzzles or are passionate about classical and electronic music or even motorization you will find lots of fun. Here are the most important tips of a crazy party maker: Complete various orders of your clients. Take care of the budget and clients' satisfaction. By making parties for others, you collect party coins to unlock special decorations. Find collectable items to unlock new office decor. Various types of tools will help you in decorating and renovating. Sometimes you will have to deal with unexpected events and also meet extraordinary characters. Some decorations you must create from the junk you find. Thanks to the large number of decorations, Party Maker gives you the opportunity to create the party of your dreams, arranging unusual places, creating unique atmosphere, and, above all, it can be an inspiration for your own real-life Party.

rows.name: Batterneers
rows.short_description: Batterneers is a multiplayer, pirate ship fighting game! Compete in the arena with your friends, using a range of unique cannons, powerups, bombs and effects.
rows.description_html: Batterneers is an exciting, action-packed game for up to 4 players. Fight across a number of different maps and game modes using a range of abilities and powerups. Do note that as of now, Batterneers only supports online and LAN multiplayer. Local multiplayer is currently not available. Battle Across a Range of Different Game Modes Deathmatch - Fight to be the last one standing with the highest score in this classic game mode. Gem Chase - Hold onto the precious gem for as long as you can while avoiding your fellow players. Treasure Hunt - Collect the most treasure to win the game! But watch out, as other players can try to sabotage you. Choose Your Approach to Combat Cannons - In order to be the best, you'll need to learn how to fire your cannons, calculate the trajectory and use a range of unique powerups to your advantage. These include tracking balls, boomerangs, summoning the kraken, sun beams, explosives and more! Bombs - The most dangerous weapon in Batterneers. Bombs can be picked up and thrown at pursuing enemies, but watch out as just one rogue cannon ball can make everything go wrong. Ship - Using the right powerups, your ship can be as deadly as any weapon in the game. Spikes, ocean swirls and rapid reloading will make anyone run away in fear.
rows.about_html: Batterneers is an exciting, action-packed game for up to 4 players. Fight across a number of different maps and game modes using a range of abilities and powerups. Do note that as of now, Batterneers only supports online and LAN multiplayer. Local multiplayer is currently not available. Battle Across a Range of Different Game Modes Deathmatch - Fight to be the last one standing with the highest score in this classic game mode. rows.name: World of Tanks
rows.short_description: World of Tanks is a tactical action game with very different gameplay depending on the vehicle type and role. Aside from regular PvP, there are competitive and clan-based modes, special PvE and PvPvE events, and much more. Whether you play to dominate or just enjoy the ride, you'll fit right in.
rows.description_html: World of Tanks offers something for everyone: Try different tactics, vehicles, and modes! ACTION AND TACTICS World of Tanks has a unique pace. Its armored vehicles are fast enough to draw you into the action, yet slow enough to give you time to think strategically. Good reflexes are always a plus, but it's smart and bold moves that can really turn the tide of a battle. Identify a weak spot in the enemy team's defense, move to an advantageous position at just the right moment, or ambush an opponent—and you'll feel like a champion. VARIED GAMEPLAY The unique pace is yours to control: there are five vehicle types that each play very differently. Generally, light tanks rely on their speed and stealth, heavy tanks on their armor, and mediums on versatility. Tank destroyers (TDs) are feared damage dealers, and self-propelled guns (SPGs) hurl shells at enemies from afar, using an RTS-like view. Almost every one of the 800+ highly detailed vehicles, spread over 11 tiers and 11 nations, feels special. RESEARCH AND CUSTOMIZATION Begin with classic tanks and progress toward mighty high-tier machines. Adjust their performance to better suit your unique playstyle with crew perks, equipment, and Field Modification. Top that off with visual customization: showcase each vehicle's unique flair with custom paints, styles, and a wealth of other options. MODERN GRAPHICS AND SOUND World of Tanks has received multiple and extensive upgrades to its graphics and physics since its launch in 2010. The maps feature unique landmarks and plenty of destructible objects. Vehicles get wet when in water, and they receive shell breaches from enemy rounds that penetrate, as well as pockmarks from rounds that bounce off. Guns and shell explosions have authentic, caliber-dependent sounds, and the acoustic environment is very rich, adding to immersion. PLENTY OF MODES: PVP AND MORE The basic mode is 15v15 Random Battles. Prominent regular modes include Onslaught (7v7 with extra special abilities), Frontline (30v30 on colossal maps with lots of tactical options such as airstrikes), and Steel Hunter (battle royale on mode-specific vehicles with field upgrades). On top of that, there are themed PvE and PvP events with unique rewards, clan-only Global Map and clan-based Strongholds, and more! BEGINNER-FRIENDLY World of Tanks is hard to master but easy to learn and enjoyable from the get-go. As a rookie, learn the basics from the Bootcamp scenarios, face easier opponents in lower-tier battles, and complete the Tank Academy missions for appealing rewards. A seasoned tanker friend can get you into the Referral Program, bagging great benefits for both of you.

rows.name: Landing
rows.short_description: Conquer gravity and land a rocket on the platform. And over and over again. But conditions will change, and the path is not always clear.
rows.description_html: Conquer gravity and land a rocket on the platform. And over and over again. But conditions will change, and the path is not always clear. You just need to fly around the location from one platform to another, but can you, when everything around you wants to break you. You will control various ships You can try your hand at both ordinary levels and mazes, where it is not immediately clear where to fly. And don't think it will be easy. Even an average level of difficulty can be problematic.

rows.name: Space Travel Idle
rows.short_description: If you ever dreamed of exploring space at a relaxed pace, here's a journey designed for you.
rows.description_html: If you ever dreamed of exploring space at a relaxed pace, here's a journey designed for you. Starting from Planet Earth, travel to all those moons, planets, and stars that you can think of. Come up with strategies to maximize your energy and resource gains, conduct research to enhance your improve your spaceship, and build infrastructures all over the Universe. You are also going to fight evil aliens from outer space in a relaxing card-battle. While the above may sound complicated, in this game, they can all be achieved with a few clicks... It's an Idle Game ! Features: Gaining Energy/Resources Discover various ways of retrieving the energy or resources on every celestial body you visit. Think of strategies to maximize efficiency in reaching your goals. Improve your scientific prowess to avoid a loss in resource gain efficiency deterioration at some destinations. Intergalactic travel Power up your spaceship engine, and set off. Bring necessary stuff with you in your spaceship to develop the new star, but don't bring too much. Remember that more weight will require more energy to fire up your engines. Make use of all scientifically possible and impossible ways to reduce your travel time, including weight reduction, trajectory optimization and space folding. Science Engage in research on your spaceship and various galactic laboratories to enhance your abilities and unlock more content Build space stations on every place you visit! Expand and utilize your knowledge as you make space your own. Battle Face various alien enemies during your journey through space. Fight them in classic card battle fashion. Enemy aliens act unpredictably. As you progress through the game, battles will become increasingly difficult and will require creative solutions. Instead of fighting manually, you can… …Automate battle strategies and fighting behavior with your own battle AI. No worries, it will be super easy to set up. Get drops from the defeated enemies to improve your battle abilities and improve all other aspects of the game as well. Legendary Boss Fights. Unlock great drops whenever you beat them! What else can you expect from the game? Regular updates to ensure there's always new content! You can enjoy nearly the entire game without needing to pay at all. Even the in-game premium currency can be obtained regularly without investing money. We will carefully watch feedback on our various channels (steam, discord, etc.). We intend to listen to the community and keep making this game better for everyone. Good Luck, and have a pleasant flight! PS: This game was initially developed by Ayatsuji_san alone as a passion project during the difficult Covid-19 year of 2020, including programming, design, and art. His good friend Berk joined in later on to make faster game completion possible. Additionally, a number of other people have supported the game with artwork and other fixes. We hope that you love the game as much as we loved making it.

rows.name: Penimorta
rows.short_description: You are a Wizard. Being imprisoned in Penimorta, a maximum security prison, has little appeal. Naturally, you've decided to bust out. The problem is... between every floor of Penimorta is a Corporeal Beast. Can you escape?
rows.description_html: Penimorta You are a Wizard. Being imprisoned in Penimorta, a maximum security prison, has little appeal. Naturally, you've decided to bust out. The problem is... between every floor of Penimorta is a Corporeal Beast. Can you escape? Penimorta is a Bullet-Hell Dungeon Crawler. You must descend twenty floors to escape it. Ten of the floors imprison vicious Corporeal Beasts. On the other floors there are mad prisoners and evil minions. Throughout Penimorta you will find Items to assist in your descent! Features: 20 Floors of Bullet-Hell Action A Random Item (or Pet) on each Floor 10 Unique Bosses 25+ Unique Minions and Prisoners Status Effects Full Controller Support A crazy amount of bullets

rows.name: Hex Slayer
rows.short_description: Hex Slayer is a turn-based strategy game where the goal is to conquer the island. Featuring special classes and custom campaigns, expand your kingdom and outwit the enemy by building huts, towers, and powerful units.
rows.description_html: Hex Slayer is a turn-based strategy game where the goal is to conquer the island. Featuring special classes and custom campaigns, expand your kingdom and outwit the enemy by building huts, towers, and powerful units. Watch your upkeep! Each map offers a unique challenge and an opportunity to fine-tune your strategy. Track your score against fellow players on the global leaderboards. Features include: Three game modes: Campaign, Battle and Endless Five special classes with unique units: 256 maps with global leaderboards Eight difficulty levels from 'Easy' to 'Impossible' 'Endless' mode featuring procedurally-generated maps of increasing difficulty Bonus scoreboards for classes, regions, Endless mode, and total cumulative score

rows.name: Sneaky Kitten
rows.short_description: Play as a fluffy cat and sneak around your mortal enemies, The Dogs! Steal their trinkets and work your way around their mansion without being seen! Sneaky Kitten is a non-violence game, that focuses on problem solving and sneakiness!
rows.description_html: Sneaky Kitten is a family-friendly non-violence game, where you play as a cat to collect coins and other trinkets. Do this by solving problems and sneaking past some non-friendly dogs. Play as a cat! Have fun playing as a cat! Experience the excitement of being a fluffy cat who can run and jump around in fun levels. The goal of the game is to sneak around the enemies (that are dogs) and steal their treasures. Exciting stealth gameplay Dogs are patrolling the area around the treasures. To steal them you have to be very sneaky to pass the dogs, finding paths where the dogs can't spot you and sometimes distract them from their original path, then quickly sneak past them before they come back to spot you. Non-Violence We know that most family-friendly games today include violence. Our philosophy at Eight Lives is to avoid violence, which is why we have made Sneaky Kitten without violence. Problem solving Sneaky Kitten is a game with tricky problems to solve and situations to get out of. Collectibles Throughout the game there will be trinkets you can steal from the dogs, unrelated to the main mission. Steal all the collectables and you might get a reward!

rows.name: Mana Maker
rows.short_description: Magic is a wonderful thing, so why not make more? In Mana Maker, your goal is to make mana so you can conjure minions to do it for you! Once you conjure Cthulhu you may ascend and unlock even more possibilities!
rows.description_html: Magic is a wonderful thing, so why not make more? In Mana Maker, your goal is to make mana so you can conjure minions to do it for you! Along the way, you can hire people to help you with other tasks such as potion brewing, scrap collecting, minion enchanting, and wand crafting! With 12 unique minions, 4 unique hirable people, 120 unique minion skins, and so many ways to play, you're bound to have fun! But magic isn't always fun, especially when dealing with dark figures such as Cthulhu! Who I am I kidding, even he is fun! Once you conjure Cthulhu, you have the option to Ascend, which will restart your game but give you a boost to your minions as well as 250 crystals(in-game currency).

rows.name: Plasma
rows.short_description: Plasma is a pure engineering sandbox. Use advanced visual programming and robotics tools to create anything you can imagine.
rows.description_html: Plasma is a creative engineering playground where you can build any device you can imagine. Bring to life your own amazing robots, factories, arcade machines, giant rampaging spiders, whole game worlds, and things that don't even have a name yet, then share them with the community. BUILD Free-form building with hundreds of components! Scale, rotate, paint, customize every aspect to make the device of your dreams. CONTROL A user-friendly visual programming tool to control behavior and logic for your devices, with advanced nodes to get anything and everything done. SHARE Explore the Steam Workshop to discover loads of devices and populated worlds, learn from others and share your own creations for others to enjoy.

rows.name: Super Walrus Entertainment System
rows.short_description: A free collection of short-form indie games made using the OHRRPGCE engine!
rows.description_html: A free collection of short-form indie games made using the OHRRPGCE engine! Additional games will be added in the future and will remain free. Explore a shady arcade and meet a variety of weirdos that change each day of the week. Collect up to 26 different toy capsule prizes. Talk to clowns, wizards, and gangsters. Most importantly, play some games! Burpin' Bros (2020) - A Bubble Bobble parody where two gassy tough guys fight for freedom while eating all the eggs, donuts, and onion rings their stomachs can handle. Ghost's Towns (2015) - Ghost's Towns is a short-form surreal puzzle game set in a world of sad monsters and suspicious strangers. You awaken in a mysterious town with no identity, no bearings, and an alien body. Ten trials await; complete the trials and find a truth. Bufanda: A Tale of Three Ghosts (2011) - It's New Year's Eve and your quiet life is about to be shattered as strange beings of another world begin to leak into your own. This game is a short-form text adventure with six different endings dependent on choices you make. Horse Game (2010) - In this game you must find the horse. Hello! I am your host. I watch you as you play the Horse Game and make sure you do not get out of control. You will explore mazes and solve puzzles in pursuit of a wonderful horse. Can you find the horse?? Time will tell. ---- Burpin Bros original design by James Paige.  All other titles created by PC Harrington. Music for all titles by Glock and mr8bit.

rows.name: Psych
rows.short_description: Play as Psych, while he escapes from a research facility run by evil slugs as they attempt to harvest him for his psychic powers. Face the evil slugs and survive the lab! Watch_out_for_Failed_Experiment
rows.description_html: A single player third-person shooter game in which you plays as a telekinetic alien fighting killer space slugs. Story Overview Psych is a rare psychokinetic creature that’s captured, studied and tortured by the Grugarians for his telekinetic properties. Psych finds a way to escape his cell while the slugs were busy dealing with a failed cloning experiment. Gameplay features -Use telekinetic powers to lift and throw object -throw power cells on generators to open doors -fight Grugarians and their turrets -survive the lab!

rows.name: Wasting Away
rows.short_description: Retro horror 3D game tells a gloomy story of the Vainonmiel camping destination. It used to be popular, until some of the visitors started disappearing without a trace. Can the Reporter survive and keep his job, or will he get arrested or fall victim to the mysterious killer of Vainonmiel?
rows.description_html: MYSTERY OF VAINONMIEL The Vainonmiel camping destination in northern Finland used to be popular, until some of the visitors started disappearing without a trace. Recently, a horribly mutilated body was found, prompting the local police to close the destination for investigation. Yet with his boss pressuring him and threatening his job, the Reporter has no choice but to sneak in and gather all the material he can get his hands on for an article about the incident. Much to his dismay, he will soon discover he is not alone in the forest... Can the Reporter survive and keep his job, or will he get arrested or fall victim to the mysterious killer of Vainonmiel? LET´S PLAY HIDE AND SEEK Wasting Away is a 3D retro horror game. The game is very much a survival horror game with a particular focus on stealth mechanics and gathering objects like notes, photos and other evidences. In addition, the game will be heavily story driven and we aim is to create intimidating atmosphere by using strong narrative, effects and sounds appropriate to the chosen style of the game. Game happens during year 1987. WELCOME TO SOLVE CRIME Player as The Reporter gets to explore and navigate their way through Vainonmiel. During playing, the player most needs to collect notes and take photos, which affect the ending of the game. Furthermore, the player is able to collect other items, which can be used, for example, to deceive enemies or heal and boost the player. In addition, during the game, the player must avoid enemies.

BACKGROUND Our entry for the Summer Novel Festival 2020. A kinetic novel with 5 sprites, 5 CGs, 3 BGs, 3 OSTs, and ~7k words.

rows.name: Escape from Tatris
rows.short_description: Escape from Tatris is a parody puzzle game with traditional gameplay and new solutions. You must collect as much loot as possible in your character's inventory. To do this, collect rows of objects and remove them. Collect combos and transfer loot to backpacks.
rows.description_html: The game was made for parody purposes, we did not pursue the goal of offending anyone or stealing intellectual property. A classic puzzle game inspired by many shooters. You have to put the loot found by the PMC into your backpack as quickly as possible, until you run out of space. The game develops trash collection skills in other games without the risk of losing your 'treasures'. Indescribable atmosphere of fighting and looting. In the game, you can endlessly collect trash without the risk of losing everything or filling up a place in the cache. It's a pity there is no open world. From the development team who made 0 projects included in the release. Unfortunately, there is no juice in our game, but you can just pause the game (innovative innovation) and drink it yourself. The game does not contain mechanics that allow you to spend money in order not to play. In case you are not immediately answered in support of Escape From Tatris, perhaps they are going to eat. If you find bugs in the game, remember, the game is under development. Collect the most points, set records and have fun in Escape from Tatris! Please do not buy our game.

rows.name: Saving Punyville
rows.short_description: Saving Punyville is an indie dungeon crawler RPG. Fight monsters and bosses in a classic 2D top down shooter style. Explore dungeons and caves to find treasures and rescue your townspeople.
rows.description_html: You are a burnt out fellow living an aimless life. Your grandpa lives in a mansion in town, but long ago kicked you out because of your various personal problems. The townspeople of Punyville, fixated on the treasures of a nearby cave, ventured inside with innocent hopes of fortune. But there were creatures inside. These creatures captured the townspeople of Punyville, locking them in dungeons. It is up to you to venture into those dark dungeons to free them. You will collect treasures along the way, meet new friends, and fight bosses. Buy weapons from Tracy's shop. Visit the alchemist to stock up on potions. Go to the local hospital if you are in need of care. Take a trip to Ecco's castle to learn how to harness the power of magic. Saving Punyville was created by a small team of three people. All of the artwork and music were made with great care. Soundtrack: -punyville-original-soundtrack

rows.name: Ten Deadly Games: Jamsepticeye
rows.short_description: Ten Deadly Games is a collection of games from different developers based around the same theme - 'Death is an Opportunity.' These ten deadly games were all created in a week for the Jamsepticeye game jam.
rows.description_html: Once again, it's late at night, and you open up your backlog folder. You choose ten games and start playing. Ten Deadly Games is a collection of games from different developers based around the same theme - 'Death is an Opportunity.' Experience slow-burn horror in 'D.I.M.', score-based physics mayhem in 'Fishin' Critical', puzzle challenges in 'More for Me,' a bittersweet narrative in 'Until Then', and more! Ten Deadly Games is a celebration of the variety and creativity of indie game developers. Dead Man's Draw A western-themed FPS in which dying gives you a chance to progress to new areas. Grim Was the Acre A humorous character sketch with lots of witty dialogue. Hoping for a Home ​A slow-paced and surprisingly heartfelt puzzle game about a goblin finding the homes of deceased humans. Organ Donor Delivery ​A game about goofy, fast-paced optimization while you're trying to box and deliver organs. Mitten's Descent ​A quick and addictive rougelike-platformer hybrid about dodging threats and upgrading when you fail. More for Me ​A cute and clever side-scrolling puzzle game about using your lives to create opportunities to progress. D.I.M. ​A slow-burn and thought-provoking horror game about interacting with a very concerning AI. Fishin' Critical  ​A sloppy and silly score-cruncher about a fish trying to steal items off of a fishing boat. Until Then ​A bittersweet look into the thoughts of a dying individual. Grave Intentions A goofy game about wooing a woman at her relative's funeral.

rows.name: Minimum Wage: Influence The Election
rows.short_description: Nail biting mischief. Manipulate the powerful with every decision you make.
rows.description_html: The presidential election is one week away, and the White House is hiring for a night shift janitor. In an attempt to be voted in for a second term, the current President has invited several celebrities to visit him at the White House. Will he make a good impression hosting distinguished guests while voters prepare to cast their ballots? As a night shift janitor at the White House, the President is counting on you to have his house spotless every morning by the time his celebrity guests arrive. Your contract prohibits you from tampering with the trash you find. It may be tempting to use what you've found to manipulate the course of the election. But if White House security catches you on the premises not doing your job, you will be fired! The MWBC radio channel is broadcasting all the latest election news and current voter surveys on whether the President is expected to be re-elected. Stay tuned for updates on celebrities coming to visit the White House, and how previous visitors are reacting to their meetings with the President. Key Features: Minimum Wage is a point and click stealth adventure game where your choices impact the story. Navigate the White House with your mouse to find and collect trash using your mop and bucket from a 2-D top down perspective. Discover trash in the dumpster, and steal items from areas inside the White House. Use stealth mechanics to time your movements past cameras and other types of security in order to plant trash you find across the White House and influence the course of the election. Some areas are harder to reach than others. To achieve the outcome you desire, you may have to find ways to use trash you collect to solve security puzzles . If you are caught by security, you will be fired. But stick with it - you can always re-apply for your job to pick up where you left off. Every night leading up to election day is a unique experience. Minimum Wage empowers you with conflicting opportunities to impact the election.

rows.name: Curse That Magic Cat!
rows.short_description: Magnus the Wizard has cursed you, turning you into a cat! Lift your curse and take your revenge by meowing, hiding, destroying things, and collecting spell books to break the spell. Curse That Magic Cat! is a lighthearted, single-player game made by students at SMU Guildhall.
rows.description_html: Curse That Magic Cat! is a lighthearted, single-player game in which you have been cursed and turned into a cat. Explore the mansion of Magnus the Wizard, collecting three spell books in each level in order to escape. Along the way, take your revenge by breaking the wizard's belongings, stealing and using his potions, and ducking under furniture to watch Magnus search for you in vain! Key Features: Magnus the Wizard, an AI opponent (whom you hate) to challenge you. Six levels in which to unleash your inner sneaky, destructive cat. Collectible cat colors to ensure you look purr-fect while taking your revenge. And yes, breakable things for your cat to push off tables and shelves. Notes: Curse That Magic Cat! is published by SMU Guildhall and developed by a small student capstone team over a development cycle of 14 weeks. Additional development on the game is not currently planned beyond its academic completion.

Smack your friends and relish in your victories as you compete in a variety of chaotic minigames. Key features: 15 exciting minigames to play and challenge Smack your friends or play alone! rows.name: Trikaya
rows.short_description: Trikaya is an atmospheric first-person puzzle game where the player explores a long-forgotten temple and pieces together a mighty and mysterious artifact to master Wind, Earth, and Fire magic to solve puzzles and uncover the intriguing history of the extraordinary artifact.
rows.description_html: A fabled artifact locked away centuries ago due to its capabilities of manipulating the elements lies within an ancient temple. Due to the lasting passage of time, the artifact has become weakened and when approached the embedded elemental gems scatter from the artifact. The player wields the opportunity to capture and claim ownership of the priceless artifact, explore the archaic temple and recover all the missing elemental gems, and restore it to its ultimate potential. Collect the Wind gem to summon powerful gusts of wind to mobilize objects. Acquire the Earth gem to create a mass of rock that can be used to shoot and destroy objects, and generate great pillars that will allow you to reach new heights. Obtain the Fire gem to incinerate objects in your way and reveal hidden paths never traversed before. Complete the artifact by attaching its final elusive piece, the White gem, to restore it to its former glory and become worthy of commanding the land's most powerful treasure.

rows.name: Square Game
rows.short_description: Test your thinking an strategy skills in a remake of the classic Puzzle-Game Microsoft Russian Square Plus! Edition
rows.description_html: The long-lost classic puzzle from Windows XP Plus! - Package lives again here. Like the original Microsoft Russian Square Plus! Edition you have to proof your ability to create matching lines of blocks before time runs out. 90s feeling repackaged. Cool music and sounds accompany you through the different game modes. Numerous simple but also more demanding achievements complete the gaming experience. Compete with others in Square Games Leaderboard Gameplay: Use the keyboard, mouse or touchdevice to move the active block around and push it into the Square so that all the blocks in a row or column match. When the blocks match , the row or column disappears. When all blocks are eliminated, you move up to the next level. The higher the level of difficulty, the shorter the time you have to solve the level. Game modes: Classic: 9 Level - like back then Arcarde: endless mode

rows.name: Touhou Block Fall ~ Yukari
rows.short_description: Reimu and Yukari team up in this puzzle game inspired by classic 8-bit Nintendo games. Manage the incoming youkai so Yukari can gap them away!
rows.description_html: Youkai are invading! Take control of Reimu as she teams up with Yukari to handle the invasion! Manage stacks of falling Bakebake, Magic Books, Sunflower Fairies, and Yinyang orbs to keep the invasion from getting out of control in this 8-bit inspired falling block puzzle game. Extermination Match two youkai of the same type to exterminate them and clear room on the board for more. Or, sandwich youkai between the top and bottom halves of a gap so Yukari can send them all away and earn extra points in the process. Use Bombs Wisely Overwhelmed by supernatural beings? Just want to earn extra points? Use bombs to clear the board of all youkai at once and take the pressure off - for now! Choose Your Path Choose between three different play modes: ReimuA, in which the youkai fall endlessly until you're overwhelmed and a stack reaches the top of the board ReimuB, in which clearing the board earns you bonuses and resets the field Rumia, in which block faces are blacked out, you get no preview of upcoming blocks, and you start with rows of blocks on the board Each mode has different advantages to play, so try them both! Bustin' Tunes, Bustin' Youkai Listen to six different Touhou tracks, each with two different arrangements (including NES-faithful chiptune arrangements) in the Music Room, and choose three of them as music presets for quick selection on the game setup screen.

rows.name: Critter Clicker
rows.short_description: Casual farming simulator with unique, flexible gameplay. Autoclicker is built-in and free. Gather resources, upgrade critters and buildings, sell your farm when you want a bigger one and never stop expanding.
rows.description_html: Critter Clicker is a casual farming simulator with unique, flexible gameplay. It has a free, built-in autoclicker. (We don't like wrist pain either.) Gather resources, upgrade critters and buildings, sell your farm when you want a bigger one and never stop expanding. Build mills to make bread to make gold. Build tracks for horses and speed up your farm work. Build smithies to increase production. And, when you're ready, upgrade your farmhouse and take your farm to the next level.

rows.name: SpaceCrash
rows.short_description: You crashed on an empty planet. Or is it...? Do you wait for rescue or do you take action and try to repair your rocket ? Explore random generated planets in SpaceCrash and enjoy the time spent!
rows.description_html: SpaceCrash is an indie game developed in switzerland. You crashed on an far away planet. You are the only survivor. The choice is yours. Do you try to repair your rocket or do you protect your gear and wait for help? In rounds of 8 minutes you try to escape the planet and increase your highscore. You control an alien astrounat in a third person view and defend yourself of angry planet inhabitants. After each round you are able to compare your highscore to your steamfriends on the leaderboard! All planets you will encounter are completly randomly generated and are never the same!

rows.name: Z Arena
rows.short_description: Take on relentless waves of zombies in this intense FPS survival game. Level up, upgrade your weapons, and see how long you can survive.
rows.description_html: Z Arena is an FPS survival game where you stand as the last line of defense against relentless waves of zombies. Featuring classic wave-based gameplay across various maps, you’ll face ever-increasing challenges while striving to survive. There are no limits—you can keep slaying zombies as long as you want. Level up to unlock more powerful weapons and upgrade them to take down enemies faster. The game also offers a 'Missions' mode, with focused challenges that test your skills in different scenarios. MISSIONS MODE The Missions mode puts you in various scenarios where your objective is to survive and complete specific tasks. Progress through different environments and face different challenges as you take on hordes of zombies. ENDLESS WAVES Endless mode is a classic wave after wave of zombies. Collect achievements across different maps, experiment with new and upgraded weapons, and see how long you can last. GAMEPLAY The Missions mode offers a variety of objectives across diverse environments, each with unique challenges that require both strategy and quick reflexes. Whether you’re battling through tight spaces or wide-open areas overrun by zombies, every level is designed to test your survival skills. Endless mode provides limitless replayability with new achievements, levels, and powerful weapon upgrades, allowing you to eliminate hordes with style. Smooth gameplay and responsive camera controls deliver an immersive experience. UPGRADING WEAPONS Standard weapons in endless mode are fully upgradable, offering improvements such as better accuracy, increased ammo capacity, scopes, and more. Upgrade stations are strategically placed on each map in endless mode, ensuring that you always have the chance to enhance your arsenal. Features Missions mode with challenging objectives across various environments. Endless mode with upgradable weapons and multiple maps to explore. Over 15 unique enemy types with increasingly challenging behavior. Timed kill streak. Special super weapons. Original Soundtracks. Steam Achievements.

rows.short_description: First there was the Whip/Nae Nae, now it’s time to Wear The Purp with the greatest rappers of all time*! Dance along with the Whiteboyz Wit Attitude in an epic FMV rhythm game, and celebrate the launch of their new album The Pursuit of Money.

Dance along with the Whiteboyz Wit Attitude, and celebrate the launch of their epic new album The Pursuit of Money. After tearing up the dance floor in an epic FMV rhythm game, take a ride to WWA’s farm and avoid hitting animals in a challenging on rails shooter! Can you beat WWA's high score in all the levels? NOTE: This game is meant to be played with a wired DualShock 4 controller, but it also supports keyboard, mouse, and XInput devices!

rows.name: Goodnight, Lily
rows.short_description: Escape the dark by navigating through nightmares made reality. Follow the light and find your way home as you are hounded by your worst fears.
rows.description_html: Flee the dark by navigating through nightmares made reality in Goodnight, Lily, a 2D platformer that throws you into the domain of your worst fears. Playing as a young girl named Lily, you must conserve lantern fuel to protect yourself from a host of terrors that threaten you as you find your way home. Scramble your way through hostile encounters, obstacles, and the ever encroaching darkness. Seek out the light and brave the enclosing horrors of the inky nightmare. Conquer the dreaded trial and escape to the waking world with courage to face the next night. Rich and Dark Visuals Traverse three beautiful levels with unique illustrative atmospheres that manifest a fantastic dreamscape. Ethereal Lighting Unique light interactions that highlight safety in the environment, and the dreamlike state the player finds themselves in. Otherworldly and Chilling Music Dynamic and unique audio featuring eerie lullabies and intense percussion that adapts to each environment. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Janosik
rows.short_description: Challenging retro pixel graphics action-platformer. Become a legendary rogue Janosik and explore the big mountain castle level full of secrets. Available for FREE!
rows.description_html: Janosik 2 OUT NOW! About the Game Janosik is a retro action-platformer metroidvania. It's fast-paced, challenging, and full of secrets to discover while exploring its big and interconnected world. The game is completely FREE and with no microtransactions! Janosik's companions were captured by the evil Count Von Zur and it’s up to you to find and rescue them from the prison. Explore hand-drawn pixel art world, find secrets, jump over deadly obstacles, roll and attack enemies, collect gold coins and find upgrades. Janosik gives you about 2 hours of single-player retro platforming fun. Janosik was a legendary Slovak highlander rogue. According to the legend, he robbed nobles and gave the loot to the poor, just like Robin Hood. The game is based on popular legends in which Janosik had special magical items given to him (usually) by witches. Those items gave him superhuman strength, protected him from bullets, or gave him the ability to jump over the trees. In some legends, Janosik fights with supernatural beings. We took inspiration from the legends both for this game and the upcoming Janosik 2, and highly recommend that you read more about this hero if you enjoyed playing our retro platformer. Please note that the Slovakian language version is available in the game’s main menu. For gamepad configuration support, please visit this forum thread .

rows.name: BEACHED
rows.short_description: A free-to-play, low-poly, open-world survival shooter where you’ll battle other players, explore massive monuments, and fight to stay alive. Build and fortify your base to defend against enemy raids, gather resources, and conquer a harsh, competitive world. Survival means doing whatever it takes.
rows.description_html: Just Updated BEACHED 0.07 IS NOW LIVE! FIGHT, FORTIFY, EXPLORE! About the Game Beached is a completely F2P (Free to Play) game. Beached is a free-to-play, third-person, low-poly survival shooter set in a massive open world where danger and opportunity collide. Battle against other players, explore sprawling monuments filled with valuable loot, and fight to survive in a harsh, competitive environment. Every choice matters—whether you’re building your base, gathering resources, or launching a raid on your rivals. Construct and fortify your base with creative building mechanics, setting traps and defenses to ward off enemy attacks. Scavenge the world for weapons, tools, and rare items to gain the upper hand. Team up with friends or face the world alone—the choice is yours, but trust is hard to come by. Explore massive monuments and points of interest, each hiding valuable resources and dangers. From abandoned airfield to military bases in a Volcano, every location offers both risk and reward. Stay on your toes—other players will be hunting for the same loot, and only the strongest will walk away with the prize. With fast-paced combat, skill-based gunplay, and intense base raids, Beached delivers a thrilling survival experience where every encounter could be your last. Whether you’re fighting for control of resources, defending your territory, or launching an all-out assault on an enemy’s base, the action never stops. Will you dominate the battlefield, or become just another survivor lost to the chaos? In Beached , survival isn't guaranteed—it's earned.

rows.name: Paralyzed
rows.short_description: Paralyzed is a challenging precision platformer with a simple objective: reach the end of each level. The challenge is that you have no input on your movement, only the color of your cube. Match your color with whatever approaches or you'll quickly meet your end. Timing is key!
rows.description_html: Paralyzed has over twenty unique levels with a large variety of obstacles and enemies. As you progress through the game the challenge increases, always keeping you on your toes and ensuring satisfaction upon level completion. Beating a level unlocks 1-2 new levels, making sure you never get stuck with only one level left to play. Level Themes The game has five different themes, each one with four levels of increasing difficulty. Cube To make an enemy cube jump out of your way, all you have to do is match the color and press space , simple right? If you're curious you could also find out what happens if you do that while you're on top of it... Laser The lasers are simpler than the cubes, all you have to do is match their color and you'll phase right through them. Be on the alert though, these 'simple' obstacles combined with the cubes can be a deadly combination! Fire These work like reverse lasers, meaning they're only dangerous when you match their color. It may sound easy but they're not something you should play around with, or you might very well get burnt. Car Cars are handled the same way as the cubes but with the caveat that while other obstacles are stationary, these move. In other words you'll need even faster reflexes if you don't want to crash. All All is... you guessed it, a combination of everything! These levels are the ultimate test of your skills combining all obstacles, resulting in the hardest levels by far. The fourth and final level of this theme is the FINALE of the game, if you beat that level you will have mastered Paralyzed. Endless Mode After beating Car-1 you'll unlock endless mode. In endless mode you'll get a new randomized level every time, keeping the experience fresh. The level will get harder and harder the further you go until you eventually die. Battle against the best players on the leaderboard to see who's the king of Paralyzed! Practice Mode If a level is too challenging to finish in one go, you have the practice mode available for training. Put down as many checkpoints as you want to get sense of the whole level, or combine them with the use of self-destruct to practice specific parts. Levels finished in practice mode won't count towards the normal game progress, but hopefully it will help you prepare for the real deal. Colorblind support The four main colors have been chosen to be easily distinguishable, no matter if you're colorblind or not. The background colors can be disabled in favor of a plain white background, should the colors be too distracting. Stats and Settings We both know what kind of person you are if you're still reading this, and we've got you covered with all the statistics you could want. See which obstacles or colors are the deadliest, track how many times you've died, 'jumped', switched color and much, much more. For settings we have the option to bind the colors to whatever you want, including a controller if that's your preference (don't do that though, playing with a controller is very hard). Multiple ways to 'jump' is also available in the settings, be sure to experiment to find what suits your playstyle the best. More features are also planned as free updates coming in 2021, so be on the lookout for those!

rows.name: R.A.V.E - Real-time Audio Visual Experience
rows.short_description: R.A.V.E is a multiplayer concert simulator for experiencing livestreamed events. Create the stage, set the lighting, and start the show! Your audience awaits.
rows.description_html: WATCH STREAMS Watch livestreams with other people in many virtual venues and environments on Desktop PC or VR. CREATE VENUES Create custom venues with our in-game Venue Builder using our library of models or uploading your own. (VR is not currently supported in the Venue Builder). CONTROL THE SHOW Control the lighting and visuals using your keyboard, in VR, TouchOSC, or other supported MIDI devices to simulate a realistic VJ (Video Jockey) setup. COMMUNICATE Communicate and interact with people using proximity voice chat, text chat, emojis, and some killer dance moves. (Text Chat and Emojis are not currently supported in VR). VR FLOW TOYS Jump in VR to spin different flow props such as Poi, Contact Staffs, and LED Swords. Choose and combine different ones to flow with. Practice your IRL skills in a safe virtual environment or try out something new.

rows.name: Amarok Dreams Demo
rows.short_description: The school of St. Alliston reopens, but can it be the same, or will things will get worse this time. Dark times happened in the school before. will dark memories change.
rows.description_html: WARNING! This is a (Remake) of an Original game called 'The Dream Theory' made by MaXoMeR Games. Me (KirleyGames), PartumGameTutorials & MaXoMeR Games have been working hard, trying our best to remake and design this horror game into a more VHS style look & more creepy horror. Story: The school of St. Alliston reopens, but will it be the same, or things will get better this time. Dark things happened in the school before, but things might change. The new headmaster Henry Clayton, tries everything to make the school better, but can it become better? You the son of Clayton, shall experience the story in your dreams, and survive when you are awake. But how long will you survive? Are you awake? Can you survive your own nightmares? Is this all real & How did this start in the first place? KEY FEATURES: ◆ Interactive story with a lot of choices tasks to complete ◆ Second chapter of scary horror - Amarok Dreams will come for YOU again ◆ Fully up view map on the phone ◆ Flashlight... on the phone Speedrun Amarok Dreams : 35 mins Puzzels Amarok Dreams: Hard Horrors Amarok Dreams: (after complete the boss task) AAAAAAAAAA!!!!! 1000000/10 Chapters: Amarok Dreams : There are 3 Chapters in the game Difficulty Amarok Dreams : Normal/Hard Have fun and good luck with your nightmares!

rows.name: Buddi Bot:  Your Machine Learning AI Helper With Advanced Neural Networking!
rows.short_description: Buddi Bot is an isometric puzzle game where you must (re)train Buddi Bot, an advanced AI with neural network technology. With just a click, Buddi will complete tasks like washing dishes or cooking a steak, by learning COLORS and SHAPES. Are you prepared for the future? Play and find out.
rows.description_html: Buddi Bot is an advanced AI designed to use neural network technology to be able to complete household tasks. However, technology can be tricky and disaster strikes when your expectations and Buddi's don't exactly meet. In this game, you will have to train Buddi to complete your tasks by teaching him COLORS and SHAPES, as well as retraining him to avoid nasty events from unfolding. KEY FEATURES : Life Made Not So Simple - Easy and clear objectives, for a human. Not so much for Buddi. YOU understand that trash goes in the trashcan, but Buddi is going to have to learn. Training Interface - Oh, no. Buddi burnt the food or put the hot sauce in the washing machines? No matter. Buddi comes with additional software with features to rewind, retrain, and command him with just a click of a button. Point and Click - The whole game is played with just your mouse. Less energy spent on understanding controls means more energy can be spent on trying to get Buddi to finally wash the dishes. Buddi Bot is a 3-D, isometric puzzle game by The University of Texas's SAGA Lab. This game was created with the intent of displaying the positive and negative effects that the advancement of AI will present to society. The simple things in life can be mitigated with the assistance of Buddi Bot, but things might turn out unexpected. So when you're telling Buddi to wash a plate, try to remember if he has thrown around any discs lately. The design and production of this game were funded by the Good Systems Texas Grand Challenge Initiative at the University of Texas at Austin.

rows.name: The Imagined Leviathan: Prologue
rows.short_description: Imagined Leviathans is a narrative survival game set in a frozen British village. Explore the countryside and unite the survivors to face down your Leviathans together.
rows.description_html: ADD FULL GAME TO YOUR WISHLIST About the Game We are developing this short experience into a new full game called Imagined Leviathans, which will greatly develop the gameplay and themes into a full 2-3 hours of play, with improved visuals and significantly more to do and see, including meeting other survivors “At fifty degrees below zero frostbite can strike in as few as five minutes” A poetic survival horror set in a future where climate change has rendered Britain an arctic wasteland. On your pilgrimage to Steel Henge you can only take what you can carry, so choose carefully what you leave behind. Immerse yourself in this starkly monochromatic world as you scavenge for fuel, take shelter in the shadows, and burn stories to stay warm. A malevolent presence lurks between the words, just out of reach. Alone, you must sacrifice everything you knew to deliver the bitter truth of this world to future generations. A brief but intense 20 minutes.

A brief but intense 20 minutes.
rows.reviews_html: “The Imagined Leviathan is one of the most novel takes on horror I’ve seen in a long while. So much of it goes against contemporary horror design, and yet it all works perfectly.” Dread XP “A wonderfully disorientating and eerie little game with a great sense of atmosphere and interesting fireside musings.” Alpha Beta Gamer “A clever take on the survival genre where every word could spell your end.” Amy Davidson

rows.name: SpellForce 3 Versus Edition
rows.short_description: The SpellForce 3: Versus Edition gives you the chance to enter the battlefields of Eo for free, letting you test your RTS skills against AI opponents or even other human players.
rows.description_html: The SpellForce 3: Versus Edition gives you the chance to enter the battlefields of Eo for free, letting you test your RTS skills against AI opponents or even other human players. Skirmish or 1-on-1 Multiplayer You can choose whether you want to take on AI enemies in a Skirmish battle, or go head-to-head with other human players of SpellForce 3 in both Ranked and Unranked PVP matches. On top of it all you can also check out the single-player scenario ‘Old Haalâyash’ to get a glimpse of what the lavishly created single player campaigns of SpellForce 3 and its stand-alone expansions have to offer. Multiplayer Races: Orcs, Humans and Elves You will be randomly assigned a faction, giving you a chance to try out either playing as Orcs, Humans or Elves. Each faction has its own strengths and traits, so you’ll need to develop your strategy to make the most of your warriors and workers. Upgrade to unlock more excitement This is just a taste of the challenge and fun that SpellForce 3’s RTS matches have to offer. When you are hungry for more, the full versions of SpellForce 3 and its stand-alone expansions Soul Harvest and Fallen God will get you access to the complete PvP experience with all factions and the full story campaign. If you love the PvP aspect of the game, we also offer the “SpellForce 3: Versus Edition - Full PvP Upgrade” DLC which contains the complete PvP experience with access to all 6 factions (Orcs, Humans, Elves, Dark Elves, Dwarves, Trolls). Please note that the full Single Player and story campaign experience is only unlocked by acquiring SpellForce 3 and its stand-alone expansions Soul Harvest and Fallen God. rows.name: Ball at Work: The Ultimate Speedrun Platformer!
rows.short_description: Experience the thrill of the high-flying antics of the Crazy Ball as it bounces around the dysfunctional office. With unique and challenging gameplay that is easy to grasp, outrageous physics and plenty of fun content, this is one wacky office that you’d never want to leave!
rows.description_html: Experience the thrill of the high-flying antics of the Crazy Ball as it bounces around the dysfunctional office. Smash through piles of books, bring down the shelves, swing over the lights and sneak through the vents to uncover the path to goal! 'Bounce around and create havoc in the office!' The simple controls make the game easy to pick up and play allowing the user to explore the environment and discover new tricks and strategies. As you navigate the obstacle course littered with water hazards and falling objects, look out for clever hints that are shown on the computer screens and on wall projections. If you still find yourself struggling in any level, just use some bonus slips and unlock a vide-guide for the level. 'Swing over lamps and sneak through the vents to uncover the path to goal' Through meticulous development and extensive testing, the physics of the game have been carefully calibrated to present a precise and engaging gameplay experience that gets more challenging and intriguing with each new level. With plenty of traps, tricks and puzzles in each level, Ball at Work has an unmistakable charm about it that will keep you coming back for more! 'Explore new tricks and techniques in a the fully interactive environment' Your run in each level is timed and scores are submitted to a global, cross-platform leaderboard to add to the competitive nature of the game-- return to one of your favourite levels and discover new ways to leap farther and jump higher to beat your best time and climb up the rankings! With unique and challenging gameplay that is easy to grasp, outrageous physics and plenty of fun content, this is one wacky office that you’d never want to leave! 'Unlock beautiful new skins, master the game and reach the top of the Leaderboard!' Do not forget to check out the Ball at Work: Boss Edition DLC to get unrestricted access to all the levels in the game and exciting and fresh new content that is added into the game throughout the year. The DLC also gives you exclusive access to the LiveWire Series where you participate in special events each month and winners of each LiveWire event win Steam Gift Cards! Features Full support for game controllers and keyboard with customisable controls Balanced gameplay progression and fun physics 44 exciting and challenging levels with 18 levels available as Free-to-Play Dedicated leaderboards for all levels Carefully selected soundtrack to set the mood Compete in the LiveWire Series and win Steam Gift Cards (DLC only) Exclusive special content is added to the game on Halloween, Christmas and much more! (DLC only)

rows.name: Planet LEV
rows.short_description: PLANET LEV-MATADERO is an immersive art experience. This oniric universe hosts animated sculptures with sound installations, as well as concerts and live audio-visual performances of artists from all around the world.
rows.description_html: PLANET LEV MATADERO is an artistic, immersive experience created by Children of Cyberspace and produced by Matadero Madrid and L.E.V. Festival. Available both in virtual reality and for web browsers, this dream-like digital universe is filled with animated sculptures and sound installations by artists all over the world: from massive moving structures that can be explored from every angle, to interactive artworks and portals to other digital worlds. It also hosts live shows and audiovisual performances, acting as a real-time immersive stage for LEV online events. The virtual scenery has been inspired by Asturian landscape, home of LEV Festival, and its dominant species are the Nimis, sentient beings that are the most renowned collectors in cyberspace. Their love for arts has made them dedicate their whole planet to the beauty of creative expression. Enter PLANET LEV to fly over its massive cliffs, lose yourself in the canyons, go inside its caves, discover astonishing artistic installations in every corner and interact with its fauna and flora. When you decide to end your journey, don't forget to stop by the desert to leave your trace and plant a tree that will stay until the last cycle of the planet.
